description:
I’m an experienced Education Counsellor specializing in Engineering, MBA, and Law admissions. With in-depth knowledge of the end-to-end admission process, I guide students in choosing the right college and course based on their career goals and academic profile.

I also provide expert assistance for NRI and Foreign Quota admissions, helping students and parents navigate the complex documentation, eligibility, and seat-allocation procedures with complete transparency and personalized support.

My mission is to make the admission journey simpler, stress-free, and result-oriented, ensuring every student gets the opportunity they truly deserve in top institutions across India.
